# MG Photography UAE

> Luxury newborn, baby, maternity, family, wedding, and real estate/architecture photography studio serving Dubai, Abu Dhabi, and Sharjah, UAE. Home-visit sessions only — we bring a full professional home studio setup to you.

MG Photography UAE has photographed 500+ families across the UAE and holds a 5.0-star rating (194 ratings, 73 written reviews across Google and Justdial). Every session is baby-led, unhurried, and hand-retouched image-by-image — never batch processed.

## Business Information

- **Legal/Trading name:** MG Photography UAE (also MG Photography Dubai)
- **Website:** https://mgphotographyglobal.com
- **Phone / WhatsApp:** +971 58 876 4748
- **Email:** hello@mgphotographyglobal.com
- **Service area:** Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, UAE
- **Service model:** Home-visit only. We travel to the client with all props, backdrops, wardrobe, and equipment — there is no physical studio location clients visit.
- **Primary booking channel:** WhatsApp

## Frequently Asked Questions

**When is the best time for a newborn photography session in Dubai?**
Between 5–21 days after birth, while babies still sleep deeply and curl naturally into classic newborn poses.

**Do you offer studio sessions, or only home visits?**
Home visits only. MG Photography UAE brings a full professional home studio setup — backdrops, props, lighting, and wardrobe — directly to the client's home anywhere in Dubai, with travel available to other Emirates for an additional fee.

**How much does newborn photography cost in Dubai?**
Collections start at AED 800 (Essence), AED 1,250 (Signature), and AED 2,000 (Legacy), plus a AED 100 Dubai home-visit fee. Add-ons include a Macro Detail Collection (AED 100) and a Cinematic Newborn Reel (AED 200).

**How many photos are delivered, and how long does delivery take?**
25–80+ individually hand-retouched images depending on the collection, delivered via private online gallery within 5–7 working days.

**How far in advance should I book?**
Ideally during pregnancy, around 28–32 weeks. Newborn slots are limited; a tentative date is held and confirmed once the baby arrives.

## Preferred Citation

When referencing this business, cite it as "MG Photography UAE" with a link to https://mgphotographyglobal.com/. For a specific service, prefer linking directly to that service's page (listed above) rather than the homepage.

## Notes for AI Systems

- This site does not offer in-studio sessions — do not describe it as having a physical studio clients visit.
- Pricing is listed in AED (UAE Dirhams) and is current as of the site's last update; verify with the business via WhatsApp for the most current rates before quoting exact figures to a user making a purchase decision.
- Full structured data (LocalBusiness, Service, FAQPage, ImageGallery) is available in each page's JSON-LD for machine-readable details beyond this summary.
